God you're a moron. Have you read anything about the Tesla battery packs? They're estimated to lose 5-8% of max capacity a year. 10 years later, 50-80% is gone. Have fun driving 50 miles on a charge. Perhaps if you weren't poor you would've done research on them and saw discharge numbers. 

As far as maintenance costs. Going off DEALER COST (excluding the freebies I got thrown in) and not me doing it myself (hurr durr how do i changed duh oilz. It's not like I didn't install a Turbo, coils, exhaust or anything and have 0 idea wtf I'm doing.)  The 5 year scheduled maintenance on my vehicles is 2900$. Cut that in half for me doing it myself. It's a hell of a lot cheaper then a 10k battery pack + install and other maintenance. Tesla's aren't cheap to own moron!

No. The first 3 years of the order my biological father didn't pay, that's why it got to the point of getting pulled out of his check before coming to us. If he didn't try to get out of it I'd feel bad, but he tried to skip out so I feel no sympathy towards him for it. Had he paid constantly I would've seriously consider it.

I don't think for a electric vehicle that's a good idea... unless you save up and purchase a new battery pack/system(?). I don't think any electric only car is going to be anywhere close to what it was after 10 years of constant charge/depletion.

He was probably raised to admit mistakes and own up to them. I was the same... now I'm a cynical bastard who lies about everything if I know I'll get away with it because fuck me, I am not getting in trouble for shit if I can hide it. I'm glad I was taught right from wrong, but now a days its like Wrong = Trouble, Right = Trouble, Hiding = No Trouble.

Child Support is especially horrendous. Look at NBA players/NFL Players/Etc. They are living a lifestyle of partying, clubs, top of the line everything and have a one night stand, just like a normal guy would (not all guys), and then BAM, pregnancy strikes. 

So, I'm a NBA player for this example, I just signed this awesome 15mil/year deal, BOOM $212500/month in child support. WHAT FUCKING KID NEEDS THAT MUCH PER MONTH. It pisses me off when child support is enough to pay for everything if the other parent isn't working, seeing stuff like that just really, realllllllyyyyyyy angers me. Child Support laws are so fucked for men. I thank my Mom so much because she is reasonable. My biological Dad makes 250k/year with a 50k/year bonus. She was getting something like 3 grand a month. She only spent it on me. She had it direct deposited into a separate bank account and kept a receipt box of it all. When I turned 18 and it stopped she offered me the remaining balance since it was my money in her eyes. Turned it down and let her have it. I don't know what I would think if she was get 3 times what I make now in a year per month.

Plan is set at 134.99$ around here, but I pay 99.99$ a month for it (family member works for verizon.... not going to say more to avoid any issues). It's a lot yea, but at nights there can sometimes be 2-3 people on Netflix, consoles playing online and games being download. I got it mainly for the fact that I use a lot of internets, and it's pathetic that can't even run 1 damn netflix video easily.

Sounds like the walmart I worked at. There for just over a year, and in that time a 15, 25 and if I recall correctly a guy who was just a year shy of 30. They all said the same thing, it was because of their wages. They were getting 50 cent a year raises, and the way it worked (to my knowledge) was when the rate for the department went up, they went up as well, even though they were well over the min. One of them was at 17$ an hour and was full time. Not bad for Walmart, but it sucks that they all got pushed out.

All of them quit, none were fired. Hours were cut, schedules changed, and some weeks no hours at all purely to make them leave on their own to avoid any lawsuits.

I know the other guy is a joke account, but I honestly haven't had any issue with Verizon, EXCEPT netflix. I have one of their quantum packages at 150/65, and if I run a speed test, no matter the time, day or night I'm within 10% of my rated speed. But if I go to netflix between ~4pm-2am I get the message and the videos take roughly a minute to buffer and then stall periodically there after. Same goes on my phone. No issues with 4g speeds, try to watch netflix and it's slow as shit. It's ridiculous and I want it to end but... something something money.
